market_question: Will Lance Stroll be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?
reasoning: Lance Stroll is a midfield driver with zero race wins and a best season finish of 9th. Aston Martin is unlikely to build a dominant car for 2026, and even if they did, Stroll would almost certainly be outperformed by his teammate. The true probability of him winning the championship is far below 0.1%.
evidence_points: Stroll has never won an F1 race or finished higher than 9th in the standings.
He has been consistently beaten by every teammate, including Fernando Alonso.
Aston Martin are not expected to produce a championship-winning car in 2026, and Stroll lacks the elite skill to win even with the fastest car.
